answer: Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
